rules.title: Jersey City Rent Control Ordinance
rules.requirement: Jersey City regulates rents in covered buildings under its Rent Control Ordinance, administered by the Office of Landlord/Tenant Relations. All 1-4 unit properties are exempt, and owners may request other permitted exemptions.
rules.key_value: Rent control for 5+ unit properties; 1-4 unit exempt
rules.exemptions: All 1-4 unit properties; other permitted exemptions via Rent Control Exemption Request; newly constructed multiple dwellings exempt for 30 years under state law
citation_aliases: Jersey City Rent Control Ordinance, Chapter 260
rules.quoted_span: (Please Note: All 1-4 Unit Properties are exempt from rent control)

unverifiable_exemptions: other exemptions under the Rent Control Ordinance require an owner exemption request

rules.review_note: Page does not state the cap formula or effective date. 30-year new-construction exemption comes from N.J.S.A. 2A:42-84.5 (state context).

rules.title: Jersey City ban on algorithmic rent coordination services
rules.requirement: Landlords may not use algorithmic rent coordination services. The ordinance is enforced publicly and privately, with fines up to $2,000 per day.
rules.key_value: ban on algorithmic rent coordination services; fines up to $2,000/day
rules.quoted_span: Prohibits a landlord’s use of algorithmic rent coordination services; includes public and private enforcement; fines up to $2,000 per day
rules.effective_date_note: Document says 'effective June 2025'; exact day not given.
rules.conflict_note: The NJ FAIR Act (P.L.2026, c.43, eff. 7/1/2027) may preempt this ordinance once it takes effect; the documents do not address this.

parsed.notes: Jersey City: rent control (ch. 260) and the algorithmic rent-coordination ban (§ 218-12) are the only city rules the provided documents support. No document addresses city-level just cause, deposits, screening fees or screening restrictions, so no rules or no-rule findings were added for those. D035 is link-only and was not used.
